Metadata.title: 2 Broke Girls
Metadata.summary: Comedy about the unlikely friendship that develops between two very different young women who meet waitressing at a diner in trendy Williamsburg, Brooklyn, and form a bond over one day owning their own successful cupcake business. Only one thing stands in their way – they’re broke.
Metadata.tagline: More Cupid, Cupcakes and Comedy In Season 3! (Season 3 DVD)

CommonSenseMedia.oneLiner: Odd-couple restaurant comedy serves up risqué humor.
